digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` must be neutral in scope inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling declarations, distinct from an undeclared child which poisons all child inheritance
Container `all_none` classification is true only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated `none`; any live undeclared child prevents promotion to `none`

Scope precedence must resolve as: any own/cited/inherited dependency path yields `paths`; else explicit parent `none` yields `none`; else all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to `none`; else `unscoped`
Plan-review signing must compute child-impact once and use identical results for both dependency hashing and scope classification without network re-reads
P9 validation must pass leaves and containers with all declared (paths or none) live children, and advise only on live undeclared children offering both path declaration and `--none` remedies
Cheap resign via immutable relation snapshot must produce identical child-derived signatures as normal signing without network fetches
